deepReviewPass.description: Current Deep Scan discovery pass. Send it when starting each pass together with that pass's total and zero completed items.

phase.description: Current workflow phase. Send it immediately when the scan enters a new phase so persisted progress advances.

phaseItemsCompleted.description: Completed authoritative coverage, receipts, or artifacts for the current phase. Increase it only after the corresponding work product exists.

phaseItemsTotal.description: Expected authoritative coverage, receipts, or artifacts for the current phase. Increase it before newly discovered work begins.

phaseProgressUnit.description: What phaseItemsTotal and phaseItemsCompleted count for the current phase.

preflightChecks.description: Current standard or diff scan preflight results. Project every helper results entry to capability, reason, severity, and status only. The server derives the item counts and visible block/warn attention items.

reviewItemsCompleted.description: Cumulative completed reviews or coverage surfaces in the current discovery pass. Increment only after the corresponding review is complete.

reviewItemsTotal.description: Expected reviews or coverage surfaces in the current discovery pass. Increase it before assigning newly discovered work.
